readout_other: Facial emotion categorization task (morphed sad-happy continuum); emotional bias score = proportion of faces categorized as happy
direction_notes: Pooling both taVNS modalities, active stimulation significantly increased positive emotional bias vs sham (t(58)=-2.09, p=0.020 one-tailed). For U-taVNS alone, active stimulation produced a significant pre-to-post increase in bias, but the active-vs-sham contrast within the U-taVNS group was only marginal (t(28)=-1.69, p=0.051, one-tailed).
safety_notes: A side-effects questionnaire was completed after each session; skin irritation was reported by 20.0% of the E-taVNS group vs 3.4% of the U-taVNS group (chi-square=3.86, p=.049), indicating lower incidence of skin irritation with ultrasound stimulation.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: In each session, participants first completed the emotional bias task, categorizing morphed facial expressions along a sad–happy continuum (Fig. 1b). Immediately afterward, taVNS was administered for 30 minutes. The initial 15 minutes served as a stabilization period to allow stimulation effects to emerge, after which participants repeated the emotional bias task during stimulation. Following the 30-minute stimulation period, participants performed the task a final time (post stimulation phase) (Fig. 1a). At the end of each session, participants completed a side-effects questionnaire to report any mild adverse sensations (eg, headache, neck discomfort, nausea, tingling, or muscle contractions). After completing both sessions, all participants were debriefed and reimbursed for their time.

flags.reason: Abstract states 'single-blind, sham-controlled, within-subject study'; no further detail on who was blinded.

The sentence labels 1.03 MPa as 'an average intensity', but MPa is a pressure unit, not an intensity unit; recorded as stated (converted to kPa) rather than corrected, and the same sentence redundantly repeats 'a centre frequency of 5.3 MHz' twice, suggesting a drafting error in the parameter list.
Only duty cycle (50%) and PRF (41 Hz) are stated for U-taVNS; per-pulse duration is not explicitly stated and was not computed from DC/PRF.

Within-modality active-vs-sham contrast for U-taVNS alone was only marginally significant (one-tailed p=0.051); pooled-modality effect was significant, so direction is recorded as mixed/unclear rather than a clear excitatory effect.
